name: BetterSleep
one_liner: Sleep app with mixable sleep sounds, meditations, bedtime stories and a sleep tracker; a subscription is needed after a free trial.
best_for: People who fall asleep more easily with background sounds or stories
People who want to build their own sound mixes for sleep
People curious about tracking their sleep and snoring
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People with chronic insomnia who need CBT-I (try a CBT-I program or clinician)
People who don't want their data shared for advertising
short_description: BetterSleep offers sleep sounds, meditations, bedtime stories and sleep tracking; it now needs a paid subscription after a trial.
long_description: BetterSleep (formerly Relax Melodies), from Ipnos Software, is a sleep app. You can mix sleep sounds, play guided meditations, hypnosis tracks and bedtime stories, and use a tracker that records your sleep and snoring. BetterSleep says the app is no longer free: new users get a free trial, then need a subscription ($9.99/month or $59.99/year on its own site, with prices varying by region and store). Its privacy policy says it shares data with advertising networks in ways US state laws count as a sale or sharing. It is a wind-down aid, not an insomnia treatment, and we found no published study of the app.
patient_summary: BetterSleep helps you wind down with sleep sounds you can mix, meditations and bedtime stories, and it can track your sleep. After a free trial it costs about $9.99 a month or $59.99 a year. It is not a treatment for insomnia, and its data is shared with ad networks unless you opt out.

pricing.notes: Free trial, then subscription required. Lifetime option (about $249.99) and family plan ($119.99/year for 5) offered. Prices vary by region, store and promotion.

privacy.notes: Policy says it discloses data to advertising networks for personalized ads, which counts as a 'sale' or 'sharing' under US state laws; opt-out offered.

seo.title: BetterSleep: Review & Pricing
seo.meta_description: BetterSleep is a sleep app with a tracker and recorder plus a large library of sleep sounds, meditations and bedtime stories.

faqs.a: Free; premium about $69.99/year. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with BetterSleep before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can BetterSleep replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. BetterSleep is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.
BetterSleep is available on iPhone and Android.
Sleep tracker and recorder; 300+ sleep sounds; 250+ meditations and hypnosis; 100+ bedtime stories; Bedtime reminders.

primary_uses: Sleep sounds and custom sound mixes
